name: antigravity-zh-cn
description: Non-invasive Simplified Chinese localization plugin for Google Antigravity 2.0 with in-app Settings UI, automatic post-upgrade updates, and untranslated string collector.

scripts.check: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => { import('node:child_process').then(({execFileSync}) => { const walk = d => fs.existsSync(d) ? fs.readdirSync(d, {withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(d+'/'+e.name) : (/\.mjs$/.test(e.name) ? [d+'/'+e.name] : [])) : []; for (const f of ['install.mjs', ...walk('core'), ...walk('tests')]) execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', f], {stdio:'inherit'}); const rt = fs.readdirSync('core/runtime').filter(n => n.endsWith('.js')).sort().map(n => fs.readFileSync('core/runtime/'+n, 'utf8')).join('\n'); execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--input-type=commonjs', '--check'], {input: 'const __AG_ZH_BOOT__ = {};\n' + rt, stdio:['pipe','inherit','inherit']}); console.log('All syntax checks passed.'); }); })"
